description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git fetch commands with various options and remote configurations. It sets up repositories, executes fetch commands, and verifies the outputs to ensure correctness of Git fetch functionalities.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository with a main and side branch, adds a file, and commits changes.

methods.name: setup_test_clone
methods.description: Clones a repository and adds remote references for testing fetch operations.

methods.name: create_fetch_all_expect
methods.description: Creates expected output for fetch all remote branches.

methods.name: create_fetch_one_expect
methods.description: Creates expected output for fetching a single remote.

methods.name: create_fetch_two_as_origin_expect
methods.description: Creates expected output for fetching 'origin' remote with specific references.
